about: Single source of truth for every command that runs an ANTS experiment or tool. Edit this file, then run `uv run python -m ants.evalkit.runbook build` to regenerate docs/runbook.html, docs/runbook/commands-full.md, docs/synthesizer/experiment-commands.md.

libero.label: ASPIRE LIBERO python
libero.prefix: LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/.libero TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1 MUJOCO_GL=egl PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl EGL_PLATFORM=device CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 .venv-libero/bin/python

modules.name: hurobo (external)
modules.role: Phone-video recordings of a human doing the task; extracts hand and object tracks (ArUco/ChArUco).

modules.name: LIBERO human demos
modules.role: 50 teleoperated demos of the book task (T2) as hdf5.

modules.name: DemoSpec converters
modules.role: Turn a demo into an object-relative DemoSpec JSON (distances as fractions of object radius).

modules.name: contracts
modules.role: Shared dataclasses: DemoSpec, Policy, Constraint, Perturbation, CaseSpec, EpisodeTrace, Skill.

modules.name: generator (System 1)
modules.role: Builds the prompt (rules + API reference + example + optional demo/scene/constraints) and extracts the program from the reply.

modules.name: Muse client (llm.py)
modules.role: OpenAI-compatible chat client for Muse on api.meta.ai. Disk cache, token ledger, hard token budget. Only place that needs META_API_KEY.

modules.name: rollout (CapHarness)
modules.role: Runs one program on one case through ASPIRE cap-harness (subprocess) and reads the run dir back as EpisodeTrace plus text feedback.

modules.name: aspire_launch (perturbations)
modules.role: Wraps ASPIRE's LIBERO env loader to apply physics/pose/camera/lighting/actuation/scale/ablate perturbations, and to log contacts. ASPIRE itself is not modified.

modules.name: planner + perturbations
modules.role: Chooses the next perturbation category (Thompson sampling or uniform) within a severity bound; turns it into a launcher spec.

modules.name: diagnoser
modules.role: Rule-based: failed episode -> named, reusable Constraint with a failure signature.

modules.name: collision world + scene levels
modules.role: Scene dump -> boxes, relations and prompt text (oracle). Builds harder scene levels L1-L3 by moving the wine rack onto the hand's path.

modules.name: experiment runners
modules.role: Run an experiment: generate, run, repair from feedback, evaluate. Resumable per sample, hard token budget.

modules.name: System 2 loop + gate
modules.role: harden(): perturb, diagnose, constrain, regenerate, never-regress gate, escalate to a human text answer. Python API only (no CLI yet).

modules.name: evalkit (log + viewer)
modules.role: RunLog writes events and programs; report.py renders a run folder to one report.html (tabs: runs, rollouts, compare, System 2, Scene). contacts.py/panda.py/phases.py feed it.

modules.name: ASPIRE cap-harness (external)
modules.role: Execution substrate: LIBERO sim, program sandbox, primitives. Own venvs (.venv-libero, .venv-sam3, .venv-pyroki, .venv-curobo).

modules.name: perception/planning services
modules.role: SAM 3 (8114), PyRoki (8116), cuRobo (8118) HTTP services the simulator process calls. Must be up for every experiment.

modules.name: dev/curobo
modules.role: Offline experiments on why cuRobo plans through the wine rack: contact log, carve margin, robot mask, collision validator.

modules.name: Meta API (Muse)
modules.role: muse-wonder-1.0 is the generator. Paid: about $13.5 per million tokens (logged). Key in .env as META_API_KEY.

experiments.title: Setup and health checks
experiments.question: Is the environment ready to run anything?
experiments.result: ASPIRE example passes in 36 s on the RTX A5500 laptop (smoke §1).

experiments.title: Make a DemoSpec from a demonstration
experiments.question: Turn a human demo into the object-relative summary the generator reads.
inputs: hurobo clips + setup yaml, or LIBERO demo hdf5
experiments.result: 4 of 26 hurobo clips usable at 6.0 cm marker (smoke §3); the measured marker is 5.75 cm, so re-extract with --marker-size-m 0.0575.

experiments.title: Exp 01: does one demo help? (bowl on plate)
experiments.question: Arms differ only in the demo section. Does the demo arm write a working program?
experiments.result: demo 1/2 samples solved (5/5 eval); no demo 0/2 (0/10). n=2: a hint, not a result.

experiments.title: Exp 02: debug in the scaled scene
experiments.question: Same arms, but programs are debugged and repaired in the real-size scene (bowl x1.227, plate x1.855).
experiments.cost: 866,299 tokens (about $11.7), first pass 600k then resumed with 320k
experiments.result: Each arm solved the debug seed in 1 of 3 samples. exp01's demo benefit was not reproduced.

experiments.title: Exp 03: explain-then-repair, one run per clip
experiments.question: With a WHY: rationale in each repair, how do the 3 good hurobo clips fare? Clip 233859 attempt 2 stalls on the wine rack and motivates exp04 and dev/curobo.
experiments.result: Config only (see run dirs and data/exp03.log); no results doc yet. Reconstructed command, taken from config.json.

experiments.title: Exp 04: which scene description helps?
experiments.question: G: which scene section (S0-S4, SP placebo) in the first prompt helps, in levels L1-L3. E: which contact evidence (E0-E3, EP placebo) helps one repair.

experiments.title: Perturbation preview (System 2 hook)
experiments.question: Does a working program survive hand-picked perturbations? (friction x0.4, bowl shift, actuation noise + latency)

experiments.title: System 2 v0: harden with the never-regress gate
experiments.question: Does the adversary + diagnoser + gate loop improve a working program without regressions?
experiments.result: Only a synthetic mock world so far (clearly marked); harden() has no CLI. A live run needs a thin driver script (not written).

experiments.title: dev/curobo: why does the planner go through the rack?
experiments.question: Tune cuRobo's robot carve, add a robot mask, validate no forbidden collisions.
experiments.result: 6 configurations compared; only the scene-aware ones (5, 6) had 0 forbidden-contact steps. One scene, one seed.

experiments.title: Agent skills (slash commands)
experiments.question: Prompts that write into the ANTS To-do artifact.
experiments.result: Claude Code slash commands. Another agent can follow the SKILL.md files as plain instructions.

experiments.title: Exp 05: perceived scene vs oracle
experiments.question: Can SAM 3 and depth build the exp04 collision world and S4 text without simulator state, and what is missing?

experiments.title: Exp 06 to 08: cuRobo on perception, scene understanding off, perceived, privileged
experiments.question: With cuRobo planning on the depth cloud (SAM 3 robot mask), does a scene description in the first prompt and contact evidence in repairs help, and how much does perception cost against a digital twin?
experiments.result: 9 runs: solved 1 of 3 (06), 2 of 3 (07), 2 of 3 (08); no blocking contact in any rollout. See the doc.

experiments.title: Exp 09 to 11: exp06 to 08 again, with the held bowl attached to the hand
experiments.question: Do the cuRobo refusals disappear when the held bowl is an attached object of the known size instead of an obstacle in the cloud, and does that change the solved count?

experiments.title: Demo vs no demo on cuRobo (simulator robot mask, attached bowl)
experiments.question: With cuRobo planning and the held bowl attached, does one human demonstration (plus S4 scene text and E3 repair evidence) beat task text only?
experiments.result: Held-out seeds 1 to 5, two samples (T 0.2, 0.7) per arm. Demo: debug seed solved in 2 and 2 attempts; scaled 5/5 and 2/5, stock 4/5 and 3/5. No-demo: solved in 5 (no) and 3 attempts; scaled 4/5 and 4/5, stock 0/5 and 0/5. The arms also differ in scene text and evidence. Source: events.jsonl of each run. Ran before the attach frame fix: spheres 9.65 cm too high.

args.desc: Hard cap on Muse Code tool/model steps per rewrite call.

Resume an existing session folder data/console_sessions/<id> instead of starting a new one. A session stores session.json, chat.jsonl, events.jsonl and runs/run-<ts>/; the navigator's New session button starts a fresh one.

Default of the dialog's Muse token cap for /policy-dev.

commands.description: Serves ANTS Studio: an Adversary | Synthesizer switch over Daniel's Harden/Replay/Versions page and the agent console. Runs start from /policy-dev in the chat (see studio.policy-dev); backend, attacks, seeds, strategy and budgets are chosen in its dialog. Every server start creates a session folder under data/console_sessions/ holding the chat log, every broadcast event and the per-run folders. While a rollout of a run it started is in progress, a live panel shows the agentview and wrist cameras: the console sets ANTS_LIVE_DIR and PYTHONPATH=tools/ants_live_hook for its children, which tee the frames ASPIRE already renders for its video (about 6 fps while the robot moves; no effect on results). Each rewrite spends Muse tokens (about $0.5 observed) and the loop stops at --synth-token-budget.

commands.title: Studio: full pipeline with /policy-dev (video to hardened program)

args.desc: Hard cap on Muse Code tool/model steps per rewrite call.

Resume an existing session folder data/console_sessions/<id> instead of starting a new one. A session stores session.json, chat.jsonl, events.jsonl and runs/run-<ts>/; the navigator's New session button starts a fresh one.
Default of the dialog's Muse token cap for /policy-dev.

commands.description: Start the server, click the /policy-dev chip, choose a marker clip with +, type the task, press Enter; a settings dialog opens; Run starts it. Stages: preflight, hurobo extraction (5.75 cm marker; 7 of 26 clips pass: 233607, 233646, 233859, 234314, 234347, 234603, 234827), DemoSpec, prompt, one Muse generation on seed 51 in the stock scene (prompt includes the measured stock scene, S4 format, and repairs add e3 contact evidence), then the Adversary loop on real cap_harness rollouts with the mock proposer. Dialog defaults (docs/studio/skills/policy-dev.json): Synthesizer on, 5 retries, Adversary on, Thompson, 2 attacks, 1 seed, 300000 token cap. Synthesizer off attacks a given .py and reports, with no tokens. Adversary off saves the program to data/deploy/. Bowl-on-plate only. Spends Muse tokens up to the cap (about $4 at 300000). Stops and spends nothing if preflight fails or another simulator is running.

The S4_L* files describe the scaled scene and must not be sent to a stock run. Needs the simulator to be free.

commands.title: cuRobo service (dev): carve margin and attached held object
commands.description: Stock service deletes every scene point within 5 cm of the robot spheres, so an obstacle next to the gripper is invisible. ANTS_CARVE_MARGIN_M replaces that (default here 0.02). Stop the supervised cuRobo first. Since 2026-11-02 it also uses dev/curobo/franka_attach.yml (64 sphere slots on the attached_object link) and reads the spheres to attach from $ANTS_ATTACH_FILE before every plan (written by tools/aspire_launch.py, planner.attach). Exp06 to 08 ran with ANTS_CARVE_MARGIN_M=0.0, which the service turns into max(voxel 0.01 m, 0.0) = 1 cm, not the 2 cm the doc first stated.

examples.title: All three arms of exp09, last attempt
examples.cmd: for a in clip_233859 clip_233832 nodemo; do PYTHONPATH=src ASPIRE/.venv-libero/bin/python dev/curobo/make_viewer.py data/runs/curobo/exp09/$a; done

commands.title: Demo vs no demo, demo arm: demo + S4 + E3 on cuRobo

args.desc: Run folder. Repeat the same --out to resume.
DemoSpec of clip 233859 (the no-demo arm ignores its content but the flag is required).
cuRobo with the robot mask from the simulator (privileged).
Attach the held bowl with its known size (privileged). Needs the dev cuRobo service with ANTS_ATTACH_FILE=data/runs/curobo/attach.json; do not run two such commands at once (one shared attach file).
Keep every planning cloud for dev/curobo/make_viewer.py.
Debug and repair in the scaled scene.
As run on 2026-11-04. The run also logged stock-scene evaluation.
Hard cap on new tokens per command. Observed: demo 204,933, no-demo 247,243 (about 2.8 and 3.3 USD).
Repair adds the contact log, the scene text and stall readings.
S4 scene text (regenerate with g_scene_text('S4','L1') in ants.orchestrator.scene_context_exp).

commands.description: Needs the SAM 3 and PyRoki services and the dev cuRobo service on port 8118 (runbook entries services.start and curobo.service). Settings saved in docs/synthesizer/demo-vs-nodemo-config.json. Run the demo and no-demo commands one after the other, not in parallel.

examples.title: Demo vs no demo, demo arm: demo + S4 + E3 on cuRobo
examples.cmd: uv run python -m ants.orchestrator.demo_vs_nodemo --aspire ASPIRE --temperatures 0.2,0.7 --explain --repairs 4 --planner curobo-sim --attach-known --save-clouds --debug-scene scaled --scenes scaled --eval-seeds 1,2,3,4,5 --token-budget 300000 --demospec data/demospecs/hurobo_233859.json --out data/runs/demo_e3_s4_sim --arms demo --evidence e3 --contacts --scene-text-file data/scene_text/S4_L1.txt
